label: TP
reason: User-controlled parameter flows directly to response writer without sanitization. The switch statement uses a hardcoded literal ('C') meaning the vulnerable branch executes every time, assigning unsanitized user input to bar which is then printed to response.

evidence.note: User input captured from getParameterNames() and stored in param variable
Switch case C always executed (hardcoded guess='ABC'), assigns param to bar without sanitization
Response writer prints bar directly without encoding, enabling XSS
